emphasis_points: Detail dedicated kitchen and pantry storage capacity: dust-shielded glass-front display cabinetry for fine chinaware, deep drawers for linens and flatware, and enclosed cabinets for cookware.
Highlight surface utility of sideboards and counter heights for meal staging, coffee machines, or buffet serving.
Describe moisture-resilient finishes, heavy-load shelf supports, and smooth magnetic catches or latch hardware.
avoid_list: Do not claim heat-proof countertop ratings unless specified as granite, quartz, or fire-treated composite.
Do not assume internal cutlery trays, modular wire baskets, or spice pullouts are included unless explicitly specified.
Do not invent soft-close damping or hydraulic lift hinges absent from attribute specifications.
tone_notes: Functional, orderly, and hygienic, emphasizing robust culinary utility, protected dishware display, and effortless kitchen workflow.
